highlights: Voice harvest no longer saves against the wrong plant when a spoken number is heard on its own, or when the plant you named was misheard and the previous one stayed selected.
Voice harvest now buzzes differently when it only guessed at the plant, and buzzes at all when the microphone dies mid-session — previously both felt like success.
Undo after a voice harvest actually appears now; it never could before.
Log Many finally has a search box and crop-type filters, and no longer wipes your whole selection when you change the zone, the event type or the date.
A harvest logged against the wrong plant can now be moved to the right one, instead of being deleted and logged again.
Recording what you put up: a freezer-walk mode that remembers where you left off across evenings.
